canonical_owner: frozen device identity/capability registry and canonical device adapters

experience_contract.capabilities: canonical capability references with exists/reachable/governed distinctions

surface_roles.idle: lightweight current device/context state and alerts
surface_roles.cli: read, pair/administer where existing API permits, forensic

rules: device UI is not device registry
sensor observation is evidence not authority
actuator request enters normal authority path
remote node is not a second Damar identity
offline is explicit and never inferred as healthy

mata_dewa.surface: bounded awareness summary, observed devices, spatial/host context, request provenance, freshness, sensor availability
mata_dewa.current_truth: canonical runtime subsystem; Sensorium lifecycle and Observation-to-Context implemented/verified

dcd.boundary: DCD is not authority; detection/proposal never directly authorizes response
